cost.name: Four 4s, 5s or 6s go in their upper box
cost.source: Cornell math department, Yahtzee strategy page
cost.quote: take the points in the upper section if they are available

cost.name: Four of a kind goes in its upper box while the bonus is open
cost.quote: Always score 4 of a kind on the top if we need it there

cost.name: Three or four 1s, 2s or 3s go in their upper box
cost.source: 1967 rule booklet, as quoted by the Yahtzee Manifesto
cost.quote: it is better to score them in the UPPER SECTION

cost.name: Upper boxes take three or more of their face, or a zero
cost.quote: Aim for at least 3-of-a-kind in every Upper box.

cost.name: A roll that fits a lower box goes there, not in the upper section
A full house goes in Full House, not Three of a Kind
cost.quote: Take the full house over a high scoring 3-of-a-kind.

cost.name: Chance takes 21 or more, except in the last three turns
cost.quote: Save it for rolls of 21+ points

cost.name: Chance stays open for the first six turns
cost.source: Hasbro rule booklet, tips and tactics
cost.quote: Leave your CHANCE roll until later in the game

cost.name: The Yahtzee box is not scratched before the last turn
cost.quote: Keep it open as long as possible

cost.name: A forced zero goes in the upper section
cost.quote: Scratch it in the Upper Section (e.g. Ones)

cost.name: With three or four of a kind and its upper box open, go for the Yahtzee
cost.source: Cornell math department, Yahtzee strategy page
cost.quote: you should definitely go for the Yahtzee

cost.name: With three of a kind, keep them, except in the last three turns
cost.quote: If we throw 3 of something, always continue with it

cost.name: With three of a kind and the bonus not made, stop rolling
cost.quote: bank the sure points in Four of a Kind or Three of a Kind

cost.name: With a lone pair of 1s or 2s early on, do not keep the pair
cost.source: Cornell math department, Yahtzee strategy page
cost.quote: will not get you many points

cost.name: With two pair and Full House open, keep both pairs
With two pair before the last six turns, do not keep both pairs
cost.quote: Don't chase full houses unless we are late in the game

cost.name: With a small straight after the first roll, chase the large straight
cost.quote: Use your remaining rolls to chase a Large Straight instead.
